title: Preservation outside a chosen local set
statement: Fix a program environment, resource limits, and execution depth. Let $s$ be a statement, $X$ a list of local indices containing every local assigned by $s$, and $\sigma$ an initial state. If $s$ can execute from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ to a state satisfying $Q$, then it can execute with the same cost bound to a state satisfying $Q$ in which every local index outside $X$ has the same value as in $\sigma$.
hypotheses_covered: There is an execution of $s$ from $\sigma$ with cost at most $T$ ending in a state satisfying $Q$
Every local assigned by $s$ belongs to $X$
